question: Which of the following folk dance forms is performed by men in Haryana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gugga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gugga:-**

 
 
• **It is a popular folk dance form that is performed exclusively by men in Haryana.**
 
• The dance is performed to pay homage to the snake god Gugga and is usually performed during fairs and festivals.
 
• The dancers wear colorful costumes and carry sticks that are used to create a rhythmic beat.
 
• The dance is characterized by energetic movements and footwork and is a celebration of the rich culture and traditions of Haryana. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khoria:-**

 
 
• is not a folk dance form from Haryana, but is actually a type of drum used in Bhangra performances.
 
 
 
• **Gidda:-**
 
 
• It is a traditional folk dance form that is performed by women in Punjab and is characterized by its lively and energetic movements.
 
 
 
• **Ghoomar:-**
 
 
• It is a traditional Rajasthani folk dance form that is performed by women and is characterized by graceful and fluid movements.
